title: deps: update reth from main (2026-04-30)
body:
Automated nightly update of reth dependencies from `paradigmxyz/reth` main branch.

🔗 Amp thread: https://ampcode.com/threads/T-019ddc9d-1d46-75e9-b9e8-644c7bd4c595

- **Networking**: Customizable discovery defaults ([#23843](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/23843))
- **DB**: Replace deprecated `MDBX_NOTLS` with `MDBX_NOSTICKYTHREADS` ([#23378](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/23378))
